يستقبلون (form X)
# يَسْتَقْبِلُونَ (yastaqbilūna) /jas.taq.bi.luː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَقْبَلَ (istaqbala)
# يُسْتَقْبَلُونَ (yustaqbalūna) /jus.taq.ba.luː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَقْبَلَ (istaqbala)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
